snippet.title: UFOTOFU: HEX - Coming Soon
snippet.description:
Create palindrome chains on a hexagonal grid and be rewarded with satisfying animations, charming sound and soothing visuals in this innovative new puzzle game by Inflorescent Games Co-op.

OUT NOW!

= = = = =
Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1797140/UFOTOFU_HEX/

itch.io:
https://inflo.itch.io/ufotofuhex

Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.inflogames.ufotofuhex

Apple:
